versions.changelog:
Initial release of content-calendar-x — a skill for building actionable content strategies and calendars.

- Supports end-to-end content planning, from strategy to scheduled calendar.
- Guides discovery and context gathering (business, goals, audience, platforms, cadence, timeframe).
- Defines 3–5 tailored content pillars and content mix.
- Generates platform-specific post ideas with multiple content formats.
- Outputs ready-to-execute content calendars with detailed structure per post.
- Includes repurposing frameworks for leveraging existing content across channels.
